subtitle: A .NET-focused toolkit of libraries and apps for business data: APIs with a rich query model, durable file handling, document parsing, and cross-cutting infrastructure — security, compression, observability, and more.

about.headline: Builder of Lyo — practical .NET libraries for real business data.
paragraphs: I'm Matthew Wherry, a software engineer based in Pittsburgh, PA. I design and ship libraries that make APIs, file workflows, encryption, compression, and background jobs boringly reliable.

Lyo (Library for Your Organization) is my open toolkit: a taxonomy-first monorepo with typed query models, Postgres-backed stores, and the workbenches I use to prove performance with published benchmarks.
